note: Quick grown-up lunches that use up the week's leftovers (part-packs). Templates, not recipes: {main} is the leftover being used up, {with} the other leftovers it can take. Not adapted for little ones. Checked by tools/check_recipes.py.

halloumi.name: halloumi
halloumi.how: Slice the halloumi and fry it in a dry non-stick pan over a medium heat for 2 minutes each side, until golden.

paneer.name: paneer
paneer.how: Cut the paneer into strips and fry in a little oil over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden.

tofu.name: tofu
tofu.how: Pat the tofu dry, cut into strips and fry in a little oil over a medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden.

mozzarella.name: mozzarella
mozzarella.how: Tear the mozzarella into small pieces.

ricotta.name: ricotta
ricotta.how: Season the ricotta with a little pepper.

cottage_cheese.name: cottage cheese
cottage_cheese.how: Give the cottage cheese a stir.

chickpeas.name: chickpeas
chickpeas.how: Drain the chickpeas and roughly crush them with a fork.

cannellini.name: cannellini beans
cannellini.how: Drain the cannellini beans and roughly crush them with a fork.

black_beans.name: black beans
black_beans.how: Drain and rinse the black beans.

kidney_beans.name: kidney beans
kidney_beans.how: Drain and rinse the kidney beans.

baked_beans.name: baked beans
baked_beans.how: Heat the baked beans in a small pan over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until piping hot.

hummus.name: hummus
hummus.how: Have the hummus ready to spread.

salad_leaves.name: salad leaves
salad_leaves.how: Rinse and dry the salad leaves.

red_pepper.name: pepper
red_pepper.how: Slice the pepper into thin strips.

courgette.name: courgette
courgette.how: Slice the courgette thinly and fry in a little oil over a medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft.

mushrooms.name: mushrooms
mushrooms.how: Slice the mushrooms and fry in a little oil over a medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until golden.

broccoli.name: broccoli
broccoli.how: Cut the broccoli into small florets and fry in a little oil over a medium heat for 5 minutes, until just tender.

cauliflower.name: cauliflower
cauliflower.how: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and fry in a little oil over a medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes, until golden and tender.

avocado.name: avocado
avocado.how: Halve, stone and slice the avocado.

beansprouts.name: beansprouts
beansprouts.how: Stir-fry the beansprouts in a little oil over a high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until piping hot all the way through. (Beansprouts should always be cooked.)

lunches.name: {Main} wrap
steps: {prep}
Warm the wrap in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 20 seconds each side.
Fill the middle with everything, fold the bottom up and roll it tightly.

lunches.name: Stuffed pitta with {main}
steps: {prep}
Toast the pitta for 1 to 2 minutes until it puffs up, then carefully split it open (it lets out hot steam).
Stuff the pitta with everything.

lunches.name: {Main} toastie
steps: {prep}
Fill two slices of bread with everything and press them together.
Cook in a dry frying pan over a medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes each side, pressing down with a spatula, until golden and the filling is hot.

lunches.name: {Main} quesadilla
steps: {prep}
Spread everything over one wrap and put the other wrap on top.
Cook in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes each side, until golden and the filling is hot. Cut into wedges.

lunches.name: {Main} omelette
steps: {prep}
Beat 2 eggs per person with a pinch of pepper.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Pour in the eggs and cook for 1 minute, then scatter everything over.
Cook for 3 to 4 more minutes, until the eggs are set all the way through, then fold in half.

lunches.name: {Main} picky plate
steps: {prep}
Cut the pitta into strips and toast them for 1 to 2 minutes.
Arrange everything on a plate with the hummus to dip.

lunches.name: {Main} lunch bowl
steps: {prep}
Put everything in a bowl, add a splash of olive oil, a squeeze of lemon if you have one and a pinch of pepper, and toss together.

lunches.name: Quick {main} soup
steps: {prep}
Put everything in a small pan with a splash of water and bring to a simmer over a medium heat.
Simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until piping hot. Season with pepper and serve with the bread to dip.

lunches.name: Crispy gnocchi with {main}
steps: {prep}
Heat a little oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat. Fry the gnocchi for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp.
Add everything else and cook for 2 more minutes, until hot.
